## Cookie Policy  

### 1. What are cookies?  
Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

### 2. Cookies we use  
| Category | Purpose | Lifespan | Provider |
|----------|---------|----------|----------|
| **Necessary** | Remembers your consent choice for 12 months | 12 months | This site (Quarto) |
| **Analytical** | Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID: G-DDVX87V0F2) | 26 months | Google* |

\*Google Analytics 4 is configured with IP anonymisation and **does not collect any data that can identify an individual**.

### 3. Legal basis  
We load analytical cookies only if you give explicit consent via the banner. Consent is recorded in your browser and can be withdrawn at any time (see section 5).

### 4. Data collected  
Page URL, anonymised IP prefix, browser type, timestamp, approximate geographic region (city-level).  
**We do NOT capture names, emails, or precise locations.**

### 5. Managing / withdrawing consent  
- Click “Change cookie preferences” in the footer at any time;  
- Or set your browser to block third-party cookies—site functionality will remain unchanged.
